Introduction

Stellar Code is the next-generation sci-fi mystery brought to you by the creators of The Witch of Ihanashi, a doujin visual novel that sold over 30,000 copies.

Overview

Prepare to unravel an extraordinary mystery.

While Stellar Code is a mystery visual novel, it deviates from traditional formats—there’s no need to identify culprits or decode intricate tricks.
Instead, the mystery you must solve is a cosmic enigma rooted in the wonders of space and theoretical physics.

No Prior Knowledge Required

You don’t need a background in science to enjoy this story.
The keys to solving the mystery will be revealed as you progress through the narrative.
All you need to do is question the unknown alongside the characters and immerse yourself in the unfolding story.

A Visual Novel Experience

As a visual novel, the primary focus is on following the story and uncovering its secrets.

short_description: Mysterious phenomena from space. A researcher's fatal accident. Cryptic codes engraved on an unknown material. Together with your brilliant sister-in-law, you must unravel a mystery that could determine the fate of Earth. A sci-fi mystery visual novel of discovery and suspense.
